data.body:
03:20 PDT. Three plan re-reviews ran after I widened file_impact on 0880/9ca8 and reworded f9b9's AC3. Results: 9ca8 CERTIFIED; 0880 and f9b9 both BLOCK -- and both blocks were on PLAN TEXT, not code, and both were fair:

* f9b9: my AC3 rewording left the Testing section still naming `rebar deps f9b9` as AC3's proving command, while AC3 itself now says that command CANNOT show an outbound discovered_from edge. A self-contradictory plan. FIXED: the Testing bullet now names the child-side read (`rebar deps <child-id>`) and states why the parent-side one cannot work.
* 0880: the correlation layer never stated the JOIN KEY aligning per-commit shape variables to per-ticket rework proxies. A genuine spec gap -- the code has one, the plan did not say it. FIXED: added an explicit paragraph -- join on the full canonical ticket id from each commit's FIRST rebar-ticket trailer; group_by_ticket SUMS per-commit shape into per-ticket aggregates; commits whose trailer resolves to no single canonical id are UNJOINABLE, excluded and COUNTED, never silently dropped; and that is why the window starts 2026-07-01 (trailer coverage 60/650 in June vs 876/907 in July).

Both descriptions edited; both re-reviews restarted.

9ca8's close was REFUSED even though its plan-review is certified: the COMPLETION verifier reported "2 unmet criteria". An earlier grep of mine filtered the findings out of the output, so I re-ran the close capturing full output -- it either closes or hands me the findings.

INFRASTRUCTURE: Gerrit REST is unreachable -- http=000, no connection inside 25-30s, though DNS resolves, TCP 443 is OPEN, and general internet is fine. So it is up at the socket and not serving HTTP: the same transient class as the 504 during pack generation earlier. Vote state for changes 2505/2506 is UNKNOWN right now. The rebar MCP server is also timing out (it 502'd earlier on set_file_impact), so I am using the local CLI as the sanctioned fallback.
